name: Pianola
author: Simon Tokumine
tagline: Tap-played grand pianola with live punch-in FX & 87 rolls
description: Turn your FM-1 into a modern Pianola: tap any key to perform 87 classic rolls with your own timing and velocity on a physical-modal concert grand, hit PLAY to punch in Pocket-Operator-style repeat, brake, and in-key pianist flourish FX, or break out to Basic Piano and Chord modes.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp (from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments). Public-domain classical rolls from the Mutopia Project.
